title: Controlled Leaf Decay
description: Adds control over leaf decay. Typical use is to speed up leaf decay.
body:
Adds control over leaf decay.

## Usage

This mod allows live reloading of the config via command:
```
/cld reload
```

The config is simple. `config/controlledleafdecay.json` lets you specify minimum and maximum times in ticks that it takes for leaves to decay.

## TODO

In the future I'm planning to add different decay probability functions / distributions, and maybe even an expression parser.
